statement: MICHELIN Guide Taiwan 2026 covers Taipei, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, New Taipei City, Hsinchu City, and Hsinchu County; Changhua is not in the listed coverage area.
locator: Paragraph listing the seven covered cities
notes: Prevents a false inference that Changhua restaurants were evaluated and failed to receive Bib Gourmand.
